dict.string: CerebralHelm uses Apple Events to focus a browser tab it already opened for a link instead of duplicating it, and to send a message from the Send text action. Every message is confirmed first, with the recipient and the full text shown.
CerebralHelm reads your contacts so you can pick who a message goes to in the Send text action. Contacts are never sent anywhere; they are only listed for you to choose from.
CerebralHelm reads your calendar events to show your upcoming schedule in the dashboard, filtered by mode.
CerebralHelm adds events you create from the Create Event action to your calendar. It does not read your events with this permission.
CerebralHelm uses your location to show the current weather for where you are in the dashboard.
